title: Multi-part content: images, audio, tool calls and tool results
why: A vision/multimodal request reaching the store. The IMAGE part is now an `image` block — text `[image 64×64 · ~255 tok]`, identity the sha256 of the decoded PNG, cost OpenAI's published tiling formula — so the base64 data URI is neither stored nor tokenized. This fixture previously froze the opposite: the blob was JSON-serialized into the block text and counted as 220 prose tokens by tiktoken. The same bytes are sent on both turns, so the diff must report the image as UNCHANGED — one block, referenced twice. Everything AROUND it still exercises the stable-JSON `content_part` path that images left: an audio part, a long opaque file id, a nested tool-call argument string and a `function_call_output`. The fixture also carries `</script>` and a lone `</` inside block text, which the HTML exporter must escape — so the HTML hash covers the escaping path too.
